descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92592 AC 13; TFA-94229 AC 1 · “Prompts, templates, and clinical rules match the prototype unless Vikram approved a change”.

Bug N22 · S1 · new

Conditional and monitoring-phrased orders never become tasks ('advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4', 'trend his peak flows twice a day', 'check her BP twice daily, call me if under 100'); the extraction prompt still excludes them

Tickets: TFA-92592 AC 3 (was decision D4) · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Note: TFA-92592 AC 3 (ready for QA) answers D4: they must become tasks. Prompts are byte-identical to e02167f; dev drops them again.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-22/S01, TC-22/S03, TC-22/S07, TC-22/S11, TC-22/S15

Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S25 Task prompts are Vikram's wording; the UAT/prompt conflict on conditional and monitoring orders is flagged

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T3 The task prompts and clinical rules are Vikram's prototype wording unless he approved a change (TFA-94229 AC 1; TFA-94229 R1; TFA-94229 R2; TFA-92592 AC 13) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress; TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U5 A conditional order ('advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4') becomes a task (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U7 Monitoring-phrased physician orders are extracted as tasks (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given handoff-docs/RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (local copy of the TFA-94229 / TFA-92592 attachment) and convex/ai/prompts/library/v1/tasks/{system,encounter-review,post-note}.md (v1.1)

When Compare the task system role, the encounter review and the post-note harvest with the prototype's task prompts

Then Wording matches except changes Vikram approved. The p72 prototype already has 'EVERYTHING ELSE IS NOT A TASK: monitoring/trending instructions, … future conditional considerations' and the same four-category whitelist, so the exclusion is Vikram's own wording: list it for Q1 as a UAT-vs-prompt conflict, not a port deviation

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94229 AC 1 / R2 and TFA-92592 AC 13, reviewed by a person; the outcome feeds Q1, it does not decide S04/S05

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method CODEREVIEW · Code review; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Vikram) · environment local · tickets TFA-92592 ready for qa; TFA-94229 in progress

Two ported task prompts lost Vikram's rule that 'continue X' is a status, not a task, so a physician may get stray tasks such as 'Continue heparin'; there is no record that Vikram approved the change.

Evidence: allure-results/20808155… (code review, needs-doc): tasks/system.md matches p72 word for word. encounter-review.md and post-note.md each dropped the prototype sentence that a bare 'continue X' is STATUS, not a task, and nothing adds it back at runtime. No Vikram approval is on record. Not recorded in the dev report or the prompt-batch doc.
